assumptions.statement: Failures from carrier APIs are almost always transient and succeed on a second or third attempt
assumptions.quote: Looking at 30 days of logs, failures from carrier APIs are almost always transient, such as network blips and brief 503s during carrier deploys, and succeed on a second or third attempt.

assumptions.statement: Northline’s rate limit provides ample headroom for retries under current peak traffic
assumptions.quote: Our heaviest carrier, Northline, allows 100 requests per second per account; our peak traffic to Northline is about 60 requests per second, so there is plenty of headroom for retries.

assumptions.statement: Only a small fraction of calls (≈1.8%) fail, keeping retry overhead low
assumptions.quote: Roughly 1.8% of calls fail, and each failure surfaces to the user as "carrier unavailable, try again."
